purpose: Curated exercise additions that make home equipment useful and make commercial-gym sessions worth the trip. This is content metadata for the next exercise-library expansion, not a replacement for exercises.json.

principles: Do not label an exercise permanently home or gym when equipment/profile context can determine availability.
Gym sessions should preferentially spend primary-strength opportunities on movements that exploit heavier loading, machines, cables, racks, or other unavailable home equipment.
Home sessions should exploit owned specialty equipment and free-weight/bodyweight movements that do not materially benefit from a gym visit.
Bodyweight exercises remain location-neutral unless a specific apparatus is required.
Load-aware gym advantage is modeled separately from equipment availability.
